MAN FROM MARS? ??
No, it's Don Bethman, a 26 year old native of
Milwaukee who is the Non-Commissioned officer in
charge of fire fighting for the Air National Guard
at Mitchell Field. Don's special equipment and train-
ing, as well as his special brand of nerve, are a part
of the fire fighting setup for the races here at state
fair park. Don, an eight year veteran of service in
the ÁAir Guard, is a specialist in the fighting of air-
craft crash fires. The suit he's wearing is made up
of asbestos and aluminum in layers, asbestos the inner
lining, weighs only 12 pounds and can withstand
temperatures up to 180 degrees fahrenheit. Even
with coat, boots, and hood, Don stated he had good
mobility in the suit. Watching Don closely on race
day is his girl friend, Miss Shirley Olson, also of
Milwaukee, who is a member of the scoring crew.
